findings.title: Concurrent builds can race for the same index key
findings.body: The cache lock now protects only the final map assignment, so two callers that both observe a missing index can run `BuildIndex` for the same key concurrently. For file-backed indexes, both builds open the same Bleve directory and can fail or corrupt the build; for memory indexes, one completed index overwrites the other in the cache, leaving callers using an index that future lookups will not return. Add per-key build coordination or otherwise prevent duplicate builds.

findings.title: Parallel startup builds race on the shared error variable
findings.body: Each `errgroup` worker assigns to the same outer `err` while builds run concurrently. This is a data race, and the value returned by a worker can be overwritten by another worker, making initialization failures unreliable. Keep each worker's build error local and return it directly; also use an atomic or synchronized counter for `totalBatchesIndexed` at line 189.
